early.scope: Positive quasiparticle Hamiltonian, B diagonal mass >=m, H>=0.5 radiation extrapolation, no direct B injection, initial A trace <= total injection, no off-diagonal bath term. Early chi bound assumes number<=2 final and friction>=1.

result.scope: Postcut vacuum diagonal mass difference assumed, no scattering/coherence injection. Numerical integral bound for specified homogeneous chi solution; thermal/density corrections after cutoff and direct B collision source not covered.
